Saxophonist and jazz educator Ray Blue has performed with a diverse group of ensembles, including the Harlem Blues & Jazz Band, the Sun Ra Arkestra, and the Ray Charles touring company. He is- the founder of Cross-Cultural Connection Inc., promoting jazz culture and community engagement.
Ray was interviewed via Zoom on June 23, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Ray Blue with me this afternoon, connecting from Peekskill to Clinton, New York. Welcome, Ray.
Thank you. Thank you very much, Monk, it’s a pleasure to be here.
I remember fondly your visit to Hamilton and I’ve been recently listening to some of your recordings and I want to say I very much dig your sound.
Well thank you. Thank you very much.
One thing I like is the — believe it or not it reminded me a little bit of Whitney Houston when you take a long tone and you play it straight as an arrow and then you add some vibrato near the end.
